items.title: Commercialising drugs in Europe: Lean models for first-time launchers
items.summary: Launching a product across Europe’s fragmented healthcare systems presents unique challenges that first-timers are often unprepared for, say experts from Cencora.

items.title: Trump signs order that nearly halves childhood immunisation coverage
items.summary: Seven diseases have been stripped from the recommendations, with changes to the MMR vaccine also advised.

items.title: Health tech’s role in obesity to expand beyond a ‘nice-to-have’
items.summary: Experts predict that DHTs such as wearables and apps will play a burgeoning role in obesity research and care, though equity concerns remain.

items.title: UK regulators greenlight Lilly’s Foundayo, intensifying Novo competition
items.summary: The MHRA is the first European regulator to give Foundayo a regulatory blessing, with the drug still under review by the EU.

items.title: BMS banks on Texas for $2.3bn multi-modal manufacturing facility
items.summary: This will establish BMS’ in-house manufacturing presence in Texas, adding to its ongoing outlicensing and research partnerships in the state.
